channel.title: Applied Linguistics — Calls for Papers & Conferences
channel.description: Aggregated, filtered feed of calls for papers and conference announcements relevant to applied linguistics, crawled and pulled from LINGUIST List, Ling Alert, WikiCFP and other sources.

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: Journal of Experimental Pragmatics
item.description: We are delighted to announce that the Journal of Experimental Pragmatics is now live! A new community owned, Diamond Open Access journal dedicated to research on meaning, inference, communication, and language use in context. Built by and for the research community, JXPrag combines transparent peer review, a novel Voluntary Action Editor model, and free publishing for authors. item.description: We are pleased to announce that the 2026 Annual Research Forum of the Linguistic Society of Hong Kong (ARF2026) will feature a special session on sign linguistics. The Forum will be held on December 6, 2026 (Sunday). Authors working on sign language phonology, syntax, semantics, sociolinguistics, acquisition, or related topics are warmly invited to submit their abstracts. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 3rd Swiss Workshop on Historical Linguistics
item.description: Context: The Swiss Workshop on Historical Linguistics, now in its third edition (2023 Zurich, 2025 Basel), aims at exploring questions of historical linguistics, including corpus linguistics, sociolinguistics, and language contact, from prehistory to early modernity. Our focus lies on the scientific study of languages with limited attestation, the methodology that unites them, and overcoming common problems, independent of time and geography. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 18th International Conference on Corpus Linguistics
item.description: The eighteenth edition of AELINCO's International Conference on Corpus Linguistics (CILC2027) will be held at the University of Ferrara, May 19-21, following the AELINCO three days schedule. The conference is organised locally by the University Language Center (CLA-UNIFE) and the Department of Humanities. The University of Ferrara is one of the oldest universities in the world. The foundation of the ‘Studio di Ferrara’ was granted by Pope Boniface IX with the papal bull ‘In Supremae Dignitatis’

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: Theoretical and Applied Linguistics@ro - "Issues 1 and 2 2027" (Jrnl)
item.description: We invite you to submit a paper or a book review to the journal Theoretical and Applied Linguistics@ro, edited by the Department of Linguistics of the Faculty of Letters (University of Bucharest) in collaboration with Bucharest University Press. TAL@ro is designed as a comprehensive and dynamic platform aimed at sparking debates and facilitating dialogue among scholars in various linguistic disciplines (e.g. phonetics, morphology, syntax, lexicology, semantics, pragmatics, sociolinguistics, etc.

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 7th International Conference of the American Pragmatics Association
item.description: We are pleased to announce the program for the 7th International Conference of the American Pragmatics Association (AMPRA), to be held 5-7 November 2026 online, with East Texas A&M as virtual host. The goal of this conference is to promote both theoretical and applied research in pragmatics, and to bring together scholars who are interested in different subfields of pragmatics (philosophical, linguistic, cognitive, social, intercultural, interlanguage, etc.).
